# wisdom-practices-20260912

## Intent

Materialize the exact owner-approved, source-provenanced wisdom practices as reachable optional graph tasks and production-gated runtime support.

## Non-goals

No therapy redesign, new research, private-case access, forced practice, new task store, automatic send, provider call, merge, deployment, installation or stable promotion.

## Worst plausible failure

A practice could suppress valid protest, invent facts or child-state, bypass safety or relational assessment, carry stale consent across issues, or treat outward communication as completed inward care. Existing precedence and the supplied negative cases must prevent those failures.

## Acceptance distinctions

G930–G962 distinguish grounded direct entrances from decline/close, raw-variable spoofing, safety and relationship precedence, and the bounded case where draft editing is required support while outward action remains primary.
